programme.title: The Titan
programme.desc: As Earth becomes inhabitable, the human race must find a new home. Hotshot Air Force pilot Rick is chosen by the military to be made capable of surviving on a new planet.

programme.desc: Anacondas have fired people's imagination since time immemorial.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Episode 1. Ronnie O'Sullivan teaches snooker fundamentals, guiding viewers through the essential skills and techniques to improve their game, the Rocket Method!

programme.title: Blown Away
programme.desc: Jeff Bridges and Tommy Lee Jones team up for this action-filled, edge-of-your-seat thriller about a mad bomber terrorizing Boston. Forest Whitaker and Lloyd Bridges co-star.

programme.title: The Ritual
programme.desc: Father Riesinger and Father Steiger, the former struggling with his faith and the latter dealing with his past, work together to complete a series of exorcisms on Emma Schmidt, a young woman who's allegedly experiencing demonic possession.

programme.title: Drowning Mona
programme.desc: When a woman drives a car into the river to her death, everyone in town becomes a suspect.

programme.title: The Couch Trip
programme.desc: When asylum inmate John Burns (Dan Ackroyd) intercepts a call and impersonates his doctor, he agrees to be the host of a radio advice show and is soon spreading his offbeat psychobabble to ultra-trendy Angelenos in this outrageous comedy!

programme.title: The End
programme.desc: When Sonny (Burt Reynolds) is diagnosed with a fatal disease, he swallows a bottle of pills to end it all! Instead, he ends up in a loony bin beside the demented Marlon (Dom DeLuise) who is eager to help Sonny succeed...one madcap attempt at a time!

programme.title: At Close Range
programme.desc: A son wants to be like his father and earn himself a place in the family crime syndicate. Together with his brother, he forms his own gang to gain his dad's respect. Efforts backfire as the father fears that he is losing control.

programme.title: Drop Dead Gorgeous
programme.desc: In the small town of Mount Rose, Minnesota, a teen beauty pageant is about to unleash a fury of very unladylike behaviour. For in this contest, going after the crown is not just a fairy-tale dream but an all-out war where you win any way you can... or die trying. A wickedly twisted, razor sharp satire with an all-star cast including Golden Globe Nominee Kirsten Dunst, Golden Globe Nominee Ellen Barkin, Academy Award Winner Allison Janney, Golden Globe Winner Kirstie Alley, Academy Award Nominee Amy Adams, Brittany Murphy and Denise Richards.

programme.title: Bring It On
programme.desc: In this classic teen comedy packed with energy and sharp humour, a champion high school cheerleading squad discovers its previous captain stole all their best routines, and now must scramble to compete at this year's championships. Starring Kirsten Dunst.

programme.title: The Adventures Of Hercules
programme.desc: The saga of the Olympian hero continues as Hercules valiantly strives to intervene in a war between the gods and save the world from certain doom.

programme.title: The Quiet American
programme.desc: Set in early 1950s Vietnam, a young American (Brendan Fraser) falls for the beautiful mistress of a British journalist (Oscar(r)- winner Michael Caine), inciting a dangerous love triangle. Love and war collide in this stylish political thriller.

programme.title: Killers
programme.desc: Spencer is just your average, undercover super-assassin. When he meets Jen, he finds true love. But a picture-perfect marriage won't save Spencer from becoming a target himself. Now Spencer and Jen are on the run for their lives.

programme.title: The Heist
programme.desc: Lonely Maiden Productions, LLC. All Rights Reserved. Under exclusive license to Signature Entertainment Ltd 2008

programme.title: Joe and Max
programme.desc: True story of boxers Joe Louis and Max Schmeling and their enduring friendship.

programme.title: Slipstream
programme.desc: A scientist goes to a bank to meet a pretty bank teller. His time machine allows him to go 10 minutes back in time and correct his approaches to her. He's shadowed by two FBI agents and the bank gets robbed.

programme.title: Good People
programme.desc: A debt-ridden couple (James Franco, Kate Hudson) take the cash they found in a dead tenant's apartment, then become the quarry of the thief who originally stole it.

programme.title: Winter Passing
programme.desc: Actress Reese Holden has been offered a small fortune by a book editor if she can secure for publication the love letters that her father, a reclusive novelist, wrote to her mother, who has since passed away.

programme.title: Red Plague
programme.desc: Journey through a world left to wind and rust, and find that home is always waiting no matter how long you've been away.

programme.title: I'll Sleep When I'm Dead
programme.desc: Will Graham thought he had gained back his soul by leaving his life behind and taking on the life of a drifter. When he learns that his brother is found dead, Will comes back to town and discovers that his death was motivated by a shocking event

programme.title: PLEASE STAND BY
programme.desc: A brilliant young woman with autism sneaks out to enter a competition not letting anything get in her way.

programme.title: Second Coming
programme.desc: Busy parents Jackie and Mark are shocked when she inexplicably becomes pregnant. Jackie insists she has been faithful, but Mark reacts with rage, knowing the baby can't be his. Will this seeming miracle bring the family closer together or tear them apart?

programme.title: I'll Follow You Down
programme.desc: After a scientist disappears during a business trip, his son (Haley Joel Osment) and wife (Gillian Anderson) struggle to cope, then they make a bizarre discovery years later that may bring him home.

programme.title: Reuniting the Rubins
programme.desc: Lenny Rubins, (Timothy Spall - The King's Speech) an up-tight lawyer, has to put his dream retirement on hold when his ailing mother (Honor Blackman - Goldfinger) emotionally blackmails him into reuniting his estranged children for a Jewish holiday.

programme.title: The Passage
programme.desc: Enlisted by the French Resistance to transport a scientist and his family into Spain, a courageous Basque shepherd must guide the group safely across the dangerous Pyrenees...and elude the sadistic Nazi captain who is determined to capture them!

programme.title: Lo and Behold, Reveries of the World
programme.desc: Oscar®-nominated documentarian Werner Herzog (Grizzly Man, Cave of Forgotten Dreams) chronicles the virtual world. He leads viewers on a journey that reveals the ways the online world has transformed how virtually everything in the real world works.

programme.title: I'm Still Here
programme.desc: Oscar®-nominated actor Casey Affleck, in his directorial debut, together with fellow Oscar® nominee Joaquin Phoenix blow the roof off of conventional fi lmmaking in this unique and groundbreaking experimental project.

programme.title: Shade
programme.desc: Hoping to take down a legendary card sharp, a trio of grifters tries to bankroll their scheme by conning a mob bagman, but his mafia pals come looking for payback.

programme.title: The Krays: Gangsters Behind Bars
programme.desc: Steve Wraith had a fascination with the Krays, and after writing them letters Reg took an instant liking to him, even requesting Steve visit with his brother Ron, in Broadmoor.

programme.title: The Krays : The Mafia Connection
programme.desc: Were the Krays' connected to the US Mafia? Featuring interviews and revelations from former US mobster and Dave Courtney's last ever interview.

programme.title: Sex, Fame & Murder: The Luka Magnotta Story
programme.desc: This documentary chronicles the life and crimes of former gay porn star Luka Magnotta who was convicted of killing and dismembering a man and posting the video online.

programme.title: 10 Most Evil Serial Killers
programme.desc: Explore the dark and twisted world of the Top Ten Victorian Serial Killers. From evil gangs with their hearts set on vengeance to sick and twisted doctors who used their knowledge to take numerous lives, the world of the serial killer knows no bounds.

programme.title: Gangster No 1 - The Freddie Foreman Story
programme.desc: In this feature documentary, Foreman reveals the untold and audacious details of the heists, double crossings, shootouts, murders and betrayals he was involved in, earning him the label of Gangster No. 1.

programme.title: The Krays - Myth Behind The Legend
programme.desc: Ronnie and Reggie Kray remain two of the most infamous criminals in British history. Legends to many, their fame was built on a fearsome reputation and almost mythical celebrity-like status, but who were the real Kray twins?

programme.title: The Feared: Irish Gangsters
programme.desc: Best-selling author Bernard O Mahoney returns to his home country to shine a light on the Irish underworld. He travels around Ireland to examine the workings of criminals, telling stories of violence and the devastating consequences it all brings.

programme.title: The Krays: Kill Order
programme.desc: This is the inside story of the Krays, told by those who stood with them and those who stood against them.

programme.title: Cristiano Ronaldo: Portuguese Prodigy
programme.desc: A natural leader capable of inspiring runs, powerful strikes and the ability to find the back of the net, he is what many deem to be a perfect footballer.

programme.title: Under the Lights: Maradona
programme.desc: Diego Armando Maradona was an iconic yet controversial football player. Over the course of his life he became, and will always be remembered as, one of the greatest players in history.

programme.title: Game On
programme.desc: The World Cup is a major event that requires seemingly endless time, money and patience. Game On goes behind the scenes to check out what happens in the lead up to the World Cup.

programme.title: David Beckham: Rise And Rise Of Beckham
programme.desc: International soccer star David Beckham's star has steadily been on the rise since his professional debut. Seemingly unstoppable, the boy-hero rose from obscurity to stardom.

programme.title: George Best: Legend and Genius
programme.desc: Best together with Denis Law and Bobby Charlton formed the holy trinity at Man Utd. Georgie was the youngest and many believe the greatest of any player to pull on a pair of boots. A moving tribute of the Belfast boy who dominated the world of football.

programme.title: David Beckham: Stamina
programme.desc: David Beckham was one of the all-time greatest footballers, one of the most famous men in the world, exceptionally wealthy and living what appeared to be a fairytale existence.

programme.title: Gazza: All the Best Paul
programme.desc: Paul Gascoigne was one of the finest footballers of his generation. Sadly, he is remembered by some as a clown who failed to use his full talent. This compilation of his finest moments from his club career, especially at Spurs, sets his reputation right.

programme.title: Matt le Tissier: Unbelievable
programme.desc: Le Tissier didn’t score ordinary goals, his strikes were powerful phenomena, and he could dribble through the densest defence.This authorised film tells his story and shows his special talents and unbelievable goals. All of them.

programme.title: Don't Take Me Home
programme.desc: The story of the Welsh international football team's rise through the FIFA World Rankings, and onto their first international tournament for 58 years.

programme.title: Gazza: The Real Me
programme.desc: Join Danny Baker and others as they go behind the scenes with Paul Gascoigne to find out more about the real character behind the headlines and the real man off the field.

programme.title: Fight Life
programme.desc: Starring different fighters in different points in their careers, Fight Life brings you a spectrum of different point of views in the fight game. This profession of mixed-martial arts has finally flourished into mainstream America.

programme.title: Ferrari 312B
programme.desc: In a race against time and all odds, the revolutionary F1 racing car Ferrari 312B will get back on the Monaco circuit, 46 years later, under the wing of it's creator, the genius engineer Mauro Forghieri.

programme.title: Harry And Snowman
programme.desc: This is the Cinderella story of immigrant Harry DeLeyer and the plow horse he rescued from slaughter. Together, Harry and Snowman beat the odds, winning jumping competitions and worldwide fame.

programme.title: The Equalizer
programme.desc: Every year, athletes keep going higher, farther and faster, shattering previous world records. But are today’s record holders really better than those of the past? Or do modern athletes get their edge from their high tech gear? The Equalizer investigates.

programme.title: Iron Men
programme.desc: In 2016 English Premier League football team West Ham United bid farewell to their sacred Boleyn Ground, after 112 years.

programme.title: Pele: The King Of Football
programme.desc: Pele was a phenomenal athlete who brought class to the game. Using his global profile to great effect, Pele supported policies for improving the social conditions of the poor.

programme.title: A Survey of Open Space
programme.desc: The film follows a pair of urbanites set out on a 4000-mile cross-continental bicycle ride in search of the last wild place in America, to their dismay, they get exactly what they asked for.

programme.title: Muhammed Ali: Fighting Spirit
programme.desc: A history tells of how world champion boxer Muhammad Ali earned his career.

programme.title: KAKA: A Legend In The Making
programme.desc: Named FIFA World Player in 2007, Kaka is regarded as 1 of the greatest players to grace the pitch. Talented, compassionate & charismatic, Kaka truly is 'a legend in the making'.

programme.title: The Weight of Gold
programme.desc: A look at the mental health challenges Olympic athletes often face.

programme.title: Secrets of Dark Fest
programme.desc: Ten of the world's best mountain bike riders gather to compete against one another in South Africa for Dark Fest, a unique and ambitious free riders event.

programme.title: Zinedine Zidane: Zizou The Great
programme.desc: FIFA World Player in 1998, 2000 and 2003, Zidane has been labeled the greatest player to ever come out of France.

programme.title: Counterattack 2022
programme.desc: Join Sabbatical entertainment as we examine the teams selected to play in the World Cup Qatar 2022. Discover the cities and stadiums where the matches were played, and explore the art and culture of the host nation in our program: Counterattack.

programme.title: Manchester United: We Are United
programme.desc: Manchester United Football Club has come a long way since its humble beginnings as a works team for the Lancashire and Yorkshire railway depot back in 1878.

programme.title: Draw
programme.desc: Around the world there is an ongoing debate over whose country had the best sports era. Maradona + Messi, Pelé + Neymar, Valderrama + James, Chicharito + Hugo Sánchez. Sabbatical Entertainment settles the debate in this original production,

programme.title: A Haunted House
programme.desc: When Malcolm’s (Marlon Wayans) girlfriend moves into his house, he soon discovers the love of his life is possessed by an evil spirit. Malcolm enlists the help of Father Williams (Cedric the Entertainer) to exorcise the demon from his girlfriend.

programme.title: 13 Assassins
programme.desc: A group of elite samurai are secretly enlisted to bring down a sadistic lord.
In a totalitarian future society, Winston Smith, whose daily work is re-writing history, tries to rebel by falling in love.

programme.title: Lars and the Real Girl
programme.desc: Lars Lindstrom is an akwardly shy young man in a small town who finally brings home the girl of his dreams to his brother and sister-in-law's home. The only problem is that she's not real - she's a sex doll.

programme.title: Timeline
programme.desc: Based on the Michael Crichton novel. TIMELINE tells the story of a professor who inadvertently catapults himself back to 14th-century France, in the middle of the 100 Years War.

programme.title: Eye For An Eye
programme.desc: Carson Philips, a hard-drinking L.A. private eye takes a case in his old hometown in Texas. While at work Philips must confront a crime boss, a shady doctor, a sexy club singer, his former lover — and his own dark, disturbing past.

programme.title: Snitch (2013)
programme.desc: A father (Dwayne Johnson) goes undercover for the DEA in order to free his son who was imprisoned after being set up in a drug deal.

programme.title: The State of Things
programme.desc: The crew is running out of money to finish their film.

programme.title: Palermo Shooting
programme.desc: After the wild life-style of a famous young German photographer almost gets him killed, he goes to Palermo, Sicily to take a break. Can the beautiful city and a beautiful local woman help him calm himself down?

programme.title: Blackthorn
programme.desc: Sam Shepard is Butch Cassidy in this thrilling western about the legendary outlaw's return from exile. After years of quiet, he embarks on his greatest adventure since his glory days with the Sundance Kid.

programme.title: Beyond the Reach
programme.desc: A high-rolling corporate shark and his impoverished young guide play the most dangerous game during a hunting trip in the Mojave Desert.

programme.title: Manderlay
programme.desc: A story of slavery, set in the southern U.S. in the 1930s.

programme.title: The Sweet Hereafter
programme.desc: This film documents the effects of a tragic bus accident on the population of a small town.

programme.title: Fading Gigolo
programme.desc: Fioravante decides to become a professional Don Juan as a way of making money to help his cash-strapped friend, Murray. With Murray acting as his "manager", the duo quickly finds themselves caught up in the crosscurrents of love and money.

programme.title: Blind Ambition
programme.desc: Four Zimbabwean men form their country's first Wine Tasting Olympics team.

programme.title: Breathe In
programme.desc: When a foreign exchange student arrives in a small upstate New York town, she challenges the dynamics of her host family's relationships and alters their lives forever.

programme.title: Insignificance
programme.desc: Four 1950s icons meet in the same hotel room and two of them discover more in common between them than they ever anticipated.

programme.title: Ice and the Sky
programme.desc: A chronicle of the professional and emotional journey of scientist Claude Lorius, who left in 1957 to study the Antarctic ice and is regarded as the first person to discover global warming and prove its existence. The documentary catches up with Lorius as he attempts to leave a life legacy — a greater consciousness of the damage that humanity is doing to their planet.

programme.title: Winter's Bone
programme.desc: An unflinching Ozark Mountain girl hacks through dangerous social terrain as she hunts down her drug-dealing father while trying to keep her family intact.

programme.title: A Late Quartet
programme.desc: Starring Philip Seymour Hoffman and Christopher Walken, members of a world-renowned string quartet struggle to stay together in the face of death, competing egos and insuppressible lust.

programme.title: Our Little Sister
programme.desc: A story that revolves around three sisters who live in their grandmother's home and the arrival of their 13-year-old half sister.

programme.title: The Humans
programme.desc: Based on the Tony Award-winning play, a family gathers for Thanksgiving in their daughter's apartment. Amidst the warmth and humor of the holiday, the tight-knit family tries to hold together in the face of an anxious and uncertain future.

programme.title: True Mothers
programme.desc: A woman with an adopted child is contacted unexpectedly by the child's birth mother.

programme.title: Force Majeure
programme.desc: A wickedly funny psychodrama of a model Swedish family—Tomas, his wife, and their children— on a skiing holiday. An avalanche suddenly bears down on them. Tomas makes a decision that leaves him struggling to reclaim his role as family patriarch.

programme.title: Things to Come
programme.desc: Nathalie is a philosophy teacher with a settled existence, juggling a rich life of the mind with the daily demands of career and family. But with the bombshell revelation that her husband is leaving her, the pillars of her life crumble, leaving her adrift but with a newfound sense of liberation.

programme.title: Only You
programme.desc: Lindsey and Jake meet on New Year’s Eve, fight over a taxi and end up having a one-night-stand. Inseparable over the following weeks they quickly fall in love and move in together. Less than a year later a trip to the doctor leads to them being pressurised to put themselves on a list for IVF treatment. They reluctantly agree. We watch them naively embark on a journey that soon threatens to ruin their relationship.

programme.title: The Salt of the Earth
programme.desc: Wim Wenders doc on the photographer Sebastiao Salgado and his work.

programme.title: Nénette
programme.desc: A documentary on a 40-year-old orangutan that is locked behind bars.
